info.name: Video Thumbnail Relay
info.summary: Video previews for hosts without FFmpeg, rendered by a worker you run
info.description:
Many managed and shared hosts don't ship FFmpeg, so Nextcloud can't create previews for video files. Video Thumbnail Relay moves that work to a machine you control.
**How it works**
1. A small Node.js worker runs on your own computer or server. It scans your files over WebDAV, renders one frame from each video with FFmpeg, and uploads it as a JPEG. 2. This app stores those thumbnails and serves them as native Nextcloud previews for video files. You see them in Files, Photos and shares.
**Features**
- Uses only the public Nextcloud API. No FFmpeg is needed on the server. - Protects the upload API with an optional shared secret, set in **Administration settings → Additional settings**. - Accepts only JPEG images up to 5 MB, and only for video files the uploading user can access. - Deletes thumbnails automatically when their video is permanently deleted, and deletes all stored data when the app is uninstalled.
**Privacy**
The app sends no data to third parties. Thumbnails are uploaded by your own worker, using your own Nextcloud credentials.
The worker and setup instructions are in the repository's `worker/` folder.
This app is a fork of [localthumbs](https://github.com/hersche/nc-local-thumbnailer) by Vinzenz Hersche.
